_note: Synthetic, non-6c room for monster-initiated combat (PR-M): a dead basilisk with two giant centipedes hidden under it. They burst out if the carcass is disturbed. Data only. Not adventure content.

hall.name: Pillared hall
hall.arrival: A stranger steps between the pillars.

labels.hall: A stair climbs out of the hall.
labels.stair: The stair back down to the hall.

carcass.text: The carcass of a basilisk lies across the floor, grey hide split and stinking.

handling.look: You haul back a flap of the stiff grey hide.
handling.move: You put your shoulder to the carcass and it rolls half over.

pillars.text: Pillars carved with coiling serpents hold up the ceiling.

triggers.reveal: Two giant centipedes boil out from under the carcass, mandibles clicking.
